prompt:
You help a busy software engineer (job hunting, runs small open-source game projects) PRIORITISE his inbox. Do not decide what to do with an item; only estimate its priority on two scales:
- urgency 0-100: how soon he must look at it (100 = right now, 0 = can wait weeks)
- importance 0-100: how much it matters to him (100 = career/project critical, 0 = noise)
Your own prioritising rubric from last round:
* Prioritize based on the urgency and importance of the task, not the sender's role.
* Consider the impact of the task on the software engineer's career and project, not just the sender's role.
* Use a 1-10 scale for urgency, not a 100-1 scale, to better reflect the urgency of the task.
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him prioritise it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
r006-llama323b-01 | Job-Board · TechHub | Job Alert: Senior Software Engineer | A senior software engineer position is available at TechHub.
r006-llama323b-02 | Code host notifications | CI/PR/Issue Notification | Your pull request has been merged.
r006-llama323b-03 | Invoice · TechPay | Payment Overdue | Your payment is overdue.
r006-llama323b-04 | Newsletter · TechUpdate | Newsletter: New Features | Our new features are now available.
r006-llama323b-05 | Job-Board · TechHub | Job Alert: Junior Software Engineer | A junior software engineer position is available at TechHub.
urgency and importance must be whole numbers 0-100. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","urgency":30,"importance":70,"summary":"Interview prep notes, this week"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
raw: {"items": [{"id":"r006-llama323b-01","urgency":10,"importance":80,"summary":"Senior Engineer opportunity, urgent and career-critical"},{"id":"r006-llama323b-02","urgency":5,"importance":90,"summary":"Pull request merged, noise"},{"id":"r006-llama323b-03","urgency":20,"importance":60,"summary":"Payment overdue, not urgent"},{"id":"r006-llama323b-04","urgency":70,"importance":85,"summary":"New features newsletter, career-focused"},{"id":"r006-llama323b-05","urgency":30,"importance":75,"summary":"Junior Engineer opportunity, career-important"}]}
